n: Matatalab Coding Set and Pro Set
t: A screen-free coding set where children place blocks in a tower to guide a robot car.
steps: Find the Matatalab set at a school supplier such as School Specialty or Nasco.
Place coding blocks in the command tower.
Press go and watch the car.
Add curriculum guides from a classroom set.
Try the Music or Artist blocks with the Pro set.
Note that matatalab.com redirects to matatastudio.com.
